title: Fixture Discipline
prompt: Implement class Cart with add(item, price) and total(). Then write TestCart whose setUp creates a fresh self.cart with one item ('tea', 3) and whose tests add more and assert totals. Assign the class to SUITE_TEST.

tests.name: cart works
tests.code:
c = Cart()
c.add('tea', 3)
assert c.total() == 3
c.add('cup', 4)
assert c.total() == 7
tests.hint: add accumulates prices; total sums them.

tests.name: setUp runs per test
tests.code:
import unittest, io
assert 'def setUp' in code, 'give the suite a setUp'
assert code.count('def test_') >= 2, 'at least two test methods'
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO(), verbosity=0).run(unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromTestCase(SUITE_TEST))
assert result.wasSuccessful(), 'cart tests failed'
tests.hint: setUp method plus at least two tests using self.cart.

tests.name: suite passes
tests.code:
import unittest, io
stream = io.StringIO()
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=0).run(unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromTestCase(SUITE_TEST))
assert result.wasSuccessful(), stream.getvalue()
tests.hint: Independent, green tests — no shared state leaks.
